findings.problem: For 'kind of' before an adjective, 'un poco', 'algo' and 'como' (estoy un poco cansado, algo cansado, como cansado) are equally common, and the hint does not rule them out.
findings.fix: hint: informal adverb, literally 'half', before an adjective: kind of tired (not un poco or algo)

back.es: half, somewhat, kind of (adverb, before an adjective)
back.example: I'm half tired today / I'm kind of tired today.

note: As an adverb, medio stays the same in standard Spanish (medio cansada, not media cansada), so a feminine example or a short note could stop learners from making it agree.
